Median wages by demographic

Source: R/data.R
wages.Rd

A dataset containing median individual earnings by various dimensions (sex, race, education, etc.) for Maryland, for adults ages 25 and up with positive earnings. The data is calculated from the 2024 American Community Survey (ACS) Public Use Microdata Sample (PUMS) data via the Integrated Public Use Microdata Series (IPUMS).

Usage

wages

Format

A data frame with 59 rows and 12 variables:

dimension

Factor. The dimension across which values are calculated.

status

Factor. Worker status: all workers, full-time workers, or part-time workers. Some groups are only available for full-time workers.

sex

Factor. The sex of the individuals.

race_eth

Factor. The race/ethnicity of the individuals.

edu

Factor. The education level of the individuals.

count

Numeric. The estimated number of individuals in the group.

sample_n

Numeric. The sample size used for estimates.

earn_q20

Numeric. The 20th percentile of earnings.

earn_q25

Numeric. The 25th percentile of earnings.

earn_q50

Numeric. The 50th percentile (median) earnings.

earn_q75

Numeric. The 75th percentile of earnings.

earn_q80

Numeric. The 80th percentile of earnings.

Source

U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey, Integrated Public Use Microdata Series https://usa.ipums.org/usa/. Analyzed using the srvyr package.

Examples

 head(wages)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 12
#>   dimension status      sex    race_eth edu     count sample_n earn_q20 earn_q25
